name: hns-lsel-curator
description: > Local Self-Evolution Loop (LSEL) curator — the CLUSTER + drain engine for the GOOS-local PROPOSE→APPLY seam closure (SPEC-LSEL-LOCAL-EVOLUTION-001). Companion-offset drain of .moai/lessons-inbox.jsonl with a drain-side severity filter that drops the ~65% Bash-timeout/sandbox noise, event_key clustering with a frequency gate, and a Generative-Agents-style 1-10 importance score. Candidates stage at .moai/state/lsel/clusters.json. M1 = drain only (NO PROPOSE, NO APPLY, NO memory/ writes).
author: modu-ai
